messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: p99 latency breach for Oakridge — EU2 dedicated pool. p99=3100ms over 15m (SLO p99=800ms). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abc123/oakridge-eu2
IncidentBot: Paging Anna (oncall) and SRE rotation. Pager duty link: https://pd.redwood.ai/incident/4712345678
Anna (oncall): On it. Joining war room. Any customer impact details?
Mike: Quick metrics snapshot: p50=210ms, p95=820ms, p99=3100ms. Request rate for Oakridge +2.4x compared to baseline. No error-rate spike (5xx stable).
Deepa: Is this shared infra? Confirming it's the Dedicated pool for Oakridge only?
Mike: Yes dedicated pool (oakridge-eu2-pool-3). No other tenants affected per routing table.
Lia: Likely noisy tenant job — recent batch ingest? Any large-context requests?
Bryan: Checking ingress logs — a small set of clients are sending long context (>=8k tokens). Spike started 18m ago.
Sam: Recommend immediate steps: 1) enable tenant-level throttling (reduce concurrency for oakridge) 2) spawn 2 warm GPU nodes into pool 3) reroute non-critical routes to warm-spare model variant rw-medium.
Anna (oncall): Running isolation step now.
Anna (oncall): ```bash
# throttle Oakridge tenant to 60% concurrency
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/internal/tenants/oakridge/actions \
  -d '{"action":"throttle","concurrency_pct":60}'
```
IncidentBot: Action accepted: tenant-throttle queued (action-id: act-8492).
SRE-Bot: Pool scale triggered by Sam (add 2 GPUs) — request id scale-332.
Mike: After throttle: p95 dropped to 610ms, p99 down to 1250ms (5m window). Still not at SLO but improving.
Lia: Initiating model fallback for non-critical routes: set route tag /v1/generate?profile=ambient -> rw-medium.
Sam: Scaling complete: nodes added and joined oakridge-eu2-pool-3.
SRE-Bot: Autoscale event completed (scale-332) — 2 x A10s added.
Bryan: With scale + throttle + fallback: p95=420ms, p99=710ms now. At or under SLO.
Deepa: Great. We should keep throttle in place until traffic normalizes and follow-up with customer about root cause (long-context batch).
Anna (oncall): Drafting customer update — please review: 
"Hi Oakridge team — we observed a p99 latency spike in your EU2 dedicated pool caused by a small set of long-context batch requests. We applied tenant-level throttling, scaled the pool, and routed non-critical traffic to a smaller model variant. Metrics now within SLO (p99<=800ms). We're continuing to monitor and will share post-incident findings. If you need a conference bridge, we can join. — Anna, Redwood Oncall"
Mike: Suggest adding next steps: replay of traffic windows, list of offending clients, and recommended client-side limit on context size.
Sam: I'll own the postmortem and traffic replay. Handoff: Sam taking over active mitigation and customer comms for next 30m, then formal postmortem.
Anna (oncall): Copy. Handoff acknowledged — I am clear. Paging back to rotation.
SRE-Bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Monitoring for 30m stabilization window.
Lia: Adding runbook tag: runbook/dedicated-pool-p99 and link to playbook.
Bryan: Noting runbook step completed: isolate, throttle, scale, fallback.
IncidentBot: Incident closed (mitigated) by Anna (oncall) -> handoff to Sam for RCA.
Sam: Thanks team. I'll post RCA draft in #postmortems within 48h. :white_check_mark:
Anna (oncall): Thanks everyone, nice coordinated run. :thumbsup:
